# A09-S51: Correspondence

Correspondence extract. Omissions are marked […].

[…]

Come and visit a different election night, where everyone present has lost in advance! ‘The Unlisted Parties’ Election Night’. Present are 4 parties who wanted to, but did not succeed in getting enough signatures to obtain the right to stand for the parliamentary election. It will be the most differentiated election night with people who nevertheless have been ambitious enough to create a party in the name of democracy.

The evening's host is The Synthetic Party and its leader figure, called ’leder Lars’ who invited. ’The Synthetic Party’ is an algorithm that collects data and mixes all kinds of voters’ wishes into an unparalleled party program – the sofa voters’ party it might also be called. Both our synthetic AI Leder Lars from The Synthetic Party and party secretary and Computer Lars aka artist Asker Bryld Staunæs are ready for interviews together with the other party leaders who have announced their arrival.

The idea and the party are created in collaboration between artist and philosopher Asker Bryld Staunæs and our digital hub, MindFuture, which in Taastrup hosts 10-12 startups. All are created to, through digital ideas and the creation of new companies, grow the world into a better and more sustainable place to live for people.

Mind Future wishes as in its name to contribute to an increased dialogue between digital companies, digital future realities and the surrounding society. MindFuture proposes one extra world goal – one more than the UN’s 17 world goals. The 18 world goal – Life with Artificials which fundamentally is a call for discussion and awareness about how we manage all the ethical challenges and opportunities that new digital technologies give us.
